messages.subject: Legend: Combine linetype and colour
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

first time I’m writing here but I can’t solve this one. Here is my code:

ggplot(data=emotion_time, aes(x = Time, y = value, linetype = Group, colour = Group)) +

  geom_line(size = 1.3) +

  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 4) +

  scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("#031926", "#468189","#031926", "#468189")) +

  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Legend", values = c(1, 4, 1, 4)) +

  ylab("Emotion") +

  ggtitle("Emotion by Time") +

  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

In the picture attached you can find the result. Everything is fine except the legend doesn’t show the dashed line. I know it has something to do with what I assign to what. I also have Variable for CS / ZM and Anger / Joy. I just can’t get the legend to look like I want it to.

Thank you

Bernd

messages.body_plain:
Hi Adam.

Have you already tried first saving the plot as an image file, and then importing the image file into your Word document? Use the ggsave() function to save the plot first, then instead of pasting, choose 'insert image' (or some similar-sounding option) in Word.

Luke

Once in word you can resize it, and move it around the page like an object.
It works for ke, but also imterested in seeing other comments.
Also, I am not sure if this is proper way to communicate my answer- so my apologies if I violate protocol.

Manuel
